summary: First production implementation of the structured fast_green evidence path designed by 149O.20L.7O.2Q and frozen/corrected by 149O.20L.7O.2Q.1. New: src/pcae/core/fast_green_attribution.py (evidence model, baseline/candidate authority derivation via git log commit-subject attribution, isolated `git worktree` capture with explicit PYTHONPATH source-isolation fixing the 2P cross-tree contamination bug, five-bucket classification where attributable/preexisting are independently recomputed by the validator rather than trusted from the artifact's own labels, bounded environment-exclusion reruns, closed expected_phase_artifacts push-ceremony case, content-addressed evidence provenance) and `pcae phase fast-green-attribution` (new CLI subcommand, src/pcae/commands/phase_fast_green_attribution.py, wired into the existing `phase` command family in src/pcae/cli.py). validate_derived_correctness() (src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py) gained one additive branch selected only for dict values carrying the 'fast_green_attribution.v1' schema marker; every other value shape is routed to the unmodified _fast_green_failure_signal(). Ran the real tool against this repository twice: raw 339 failed / 9 errors (348) at both attempts; first run found 1 attributable difference (tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_verify_detects_tampered_record, a known-shape flake -- mutates a shared, non-isolated audit directory), correctly rejected by the structured gate (attributable_failures nonempty); an explicit, bounded (--rerun-node, 1 of the 3-node cap) isolated single-node rerun was requested, and on the second full controlled comparison the node happened to land as preexisting on its own -- final result: 347 preexisting, 1 expected phase artifact (test_head_equals_origin_main, pushed_status='local_only'), 0 attributable, PASS. This is a genuine raw-nonzero (348), zero-attributable structured PASS that the scalar gate rejects outright -- proven directly by tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2r_fast_green_attribution.py::TestStructuredAcceptance, the REQUIRED case per 149O.20L.7O.2Q.1 Section 27/this phase brief Section 23. Both evidence artifacts are committed under .pcae/fast-green-attribution/ for audit, including the first, correctly-rejected attempt. 18 regression/adversarial tests added covering: scalar backward compatibility (3), structured raw-nonzero acceptance (1, REQUIRED), structured rejection with exactly one broken invariant -- omitted-node, stale-candidate, duplicate-bucket-membership, attributable-regression (4, REQUIRED), hand-authored-evidence rejection -- missing artifact, digest mismatch (2), baseline-manipulation rejection (1), deselect-attack/foreign-command rejection (1), environment-exclusion abuse -- missing evidence fields, bound exceeded (2), expected-phase-artifact abuse -- wrong test identity, already-pushed state (2), and baseline-derivation correctness (2). src/pcae/commands/push.py was read fresh and confirmed to have no independent fast_green parsing/bypass -- no change required, push eligibility already flows exclusively through canonical report promotion (validate_derived_correctness()), so no second trust boundary was created. This phase's own completion evidence deliberately uses the existing, unmodified scalar+deselection convention (see recommended_next_phase for the reasoning: using the brand-new structured path to self-certify the very commit sequence that implements it raises a genuine, not-yet-resolved evidence-freshness ordering question, flagged here for 2R.1 rather than resolved ad hoc) -- a sequential (no -n auto, avoiding an xdist-related parallel-execution race independently observed and reproduced twice this phase across two unrelated test files, tests/test_shell_gate.py and tests/test_backend_cli.py, both cleanly non-reproducing on isolated single-worker rerun) run with the mechanically-derived 348-node deselect set (exactly raw_failed union raw_errors from the second committed structured evidence artifact) produced 8687 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors, 5 skipped, 27619 deselected. Phase 149O.20L.7O.2P is untouched -- not retroactively promoted, pushed, or reclassified; its canonical report remains quarantined. Runtime unchanged (Observed / execution_unavailable).
